directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write on the topic Changes in the Way of Education. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
In recent years, the way of education has witnessed significant changes. To begin with, traditional face-to-face teaching has gradually integrated with online learning. For example, during the pandemic, many schools and universities turned to online platforms like Zoom and DingTalk to deliver courses, allowing students to study from home. 

In addition, the evaluation system has also changed. Instead of relying solely on final exams, educators now pay more attention to students' daily performance, including class participation, group projects, and online assignments. This comprehensive evaluation can more accurately reflect students' overall learning abilities. 

Furthermore, the focus of education has shifted from rote memorization to cultivating students' critical thinking and practical skills. Teachers encourage students to ask questions, explore new ideas, and apply knowledge to real-life situations. 

In conclusion, these changes in the way of education are beneficial as they adapt to the development of society and better prepare students for the future.
